question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_rental_per_customer AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           p.payment_date,
           p.rental_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date ASC) as rn
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
),
first_rentals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, rental_id
    FROM first_rental_per_customer
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_rental_ratings AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, fr.rental_id, r.inventory_id, i.film_id, f.rating
    FROM first_rentals fr
    JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_amount_spent,
        COUNT(r.rental_id) as total_rentals
    FROM payment p
    LEFT JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    frr.rating,
    AVG(cs.total_amount_spent) as avg_total_amount_spent,
    AVG(cs.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rental_ratings frr
JOIN customer_stats cs ON frr.customer_id = cs.customer_id
GROUP BY frr.rating
ORDER BY frr.rating

WITH first_rental_per_customer AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id,
           p.payment_date,
           p.rental_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date ASC) as rn
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
),
first_rentals AS (
    SELECT customer_id, rental_id
    FROM first_rental_per_customer
    WHERE rn = 1
),
first_rental_ratings AS (
    SELECT fr.customer_id, fr.rental_id, r.inventory_id, i.film_id, f.rating
    FROM first_rentals fr
    JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_amount_spent
    FROM payment p
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    frr.rating,
    AVG(cs.total_amount_spent) as avg_total_amount_spent
FROM first_rental_ratings frr
JOIN customer_spending cs ON frr.customer_id = cs.customer_id
GROUP BY frr.rating
ORDER BY frr.rating
